errors: Phase 2 first attempt fanned out 5 enrich-propertymark requests in parallel (offsets 0/50/100/150/200, limit 50). pg_net timed out all 5 at 120s — only the first acquired a worker (HTTP Request/Response time 119,985ms); the other 4 stuck in DNS for the full 120s.
